review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–94). It declares no definitions, structures or classes. Its only declaration is the theorem `Module.Projective.free_of_isLocalRing`. Its statement uses Mathlib's `IsLocalRing`, `Module.Projective` and `Module.Free`. Its proof uses Mathlib's `RingEquiv.opOp`, `Module.compHom`, `Module.Projective.of_equiv`, `Module.Free.of_equiv` and `Ring.jacobson`, together with the library's own `free_of_isUnit_compl_arbitraryRank`. It introduces no competing version of a Mathlib concept. A grep of Mathlib for `free_of_isLocalRing` and for projective-module lemmas over local rings found nothing. Even if something matched, the rubric excludes duplication of a standalone theorem. I did not search the other Formal Frontier libraries for overlapping concepts. Nothing in this file points to one.
